newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco to launch 'economic' motorbike in November.
newsitem.headline: Morocco to launch 'economic' motorbike in November.

text.p: Moroccan Societe des Industries Mecaniques de Fes (SIMEF) will launch "an economic" motorbike called VEGA at a starting price of $569 in November, the trade ministry said on Friday.

"The VEGA motorbike will be produced locally by SIMEF to respond to increasing demand for such a product. The starting price was set at 4,950 dirhams including taxes," the ministry said in a statement.
The motocycle, with a 50 cc engine, will be built at SIMEF's plant in the central city of Fes, it added.
SIMEF was given the green light to produce the motorbike after it reached an agreement with the trade ministry.
Established in Fes in 1974, SIMEF has a capital of 27 million dirhams and produces more than 100,000 engines, including engines for motorbikes.
The average price for a motorbike is $1,000 on the local market.
